input.quote: ARTICLE XXI EFFECT OF TERMINATION Upon termination of this Agreement: for any reason (a) the rights and licenses granted to Licensee pursuant to this Agreement will automatically terminate, and (b) Licensee shall, within five (5) days, ship to Licensor all Licensed Technology, API's Documentation with respect to the Licensed Technology and other Confidential Information in Licensee's possession or control
input.rationale: The Agreement has no post-termination transition or data-return provision anywhere. Article XXI (Effect of Termination) runs one way only: licences terminate and Licensee must ship back Licensor's Licensed Technology and Confidential Information with an officer's certificate; nothing requires Licensor to help us migrate or to give back our own trading/market data held on its hosted platform. General Provisions and Article XX contain no exit mechanics either. Because this is a hosted FX platform where Licensor holds our data, the omission fails the fallback and approaches walk-away territory (no data return). We have inserted the fallback position only: at least 90 days of transition assistance and export of our data within 30 days of expiry or termination. We did not add the preferred six-month/then-current-rates and certified-deletion mechanics, which remain available if Licensor prefers that structure.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data export obligation
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement gives Licensor a certified return of its materials on termination but gives us nothing back, so we have added our fallback exit position: at least 90 days of transition assistance and export of our data within 30 days of expiry or termination.

ops.text: TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND DATA EXPORT Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall, at Licensee's request, provide transition assistance to Licensee for a period of at least ninety (90) days, and shall, within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination, export and deliver to Licensee all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Licensee that is in Licensor's possession or control.
